scope: Pinned terminfo.dev@4.0.0 aggregate replay: extensions.osc-633-vscode and extensions.semantic-prompts read only the declared semanticPrompts capability and perform no readback, so both pinned paths are inconclusive by design; the exact pinned registrations are replayed from the retained bundle beside two admitted, separately receipted lifecycle publications (OSC 133 A-D, ntilde-owned-osc133-graded-v1; OSC 633 A-D, ntilde-owned-osc633-graded-v1). The aggregate effect contracts are separately identified and never attributed to the pinned probes or to each other: ntilde-semantic-prompts-aggregate-effect-v1 is supported over the four admitted OSC 133 lifecycle claims, and ntilde-osc633-vscode-aggregate-effect-v1 stays inconclusive until the OSC 633 E command-line and P property publications (#983) exist. No new collection and no production change; no real shell, remote delivery, command exit status or commandFinished readback; no stock, Core, Modern or common-harness claim; the sum of the marker publications is never an upstream supported verdict.
